# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified `dist/leaflet.js`, `dist/leaflet.css`, and `LICENSE` from the
[`leaflet@1.9.4` npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/leaflet/v/1.9.4), downloaded via unpkg.
The JavaScript and CSS match the SHA-256 integrity hashes in Leaflet's official quick-start guide:

- JavaScript: `20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=`
- CSS: `p4NxAoJBhIIN+hmNHrzRCf9tD/miZyoHS5obTRR9BMY=`

The dashboard uses custom priority markers, so Leaflet's default marker and layer-control images are not needed.
Leaflet is distributed under the BSD 2-Clause license included here.
